claim.statement: relish import writes equivalent Reliaburger TOML to stdout and relish export writes Kubernetes YAML (Deployments or DaemonSets, Services, Ingresses, HPAs, Jobs, CronJobs, Namespaces), reporting what it cannot express.

sources.quote: `relish export -f app.toml` goes the other way
It reports what it can't express: firewall and egress
These are migration tools, not runtime interfaces.

claim.measurable: relish import -f deploy.yaml > app.toml; relish apply app.toml; relish export -f app.toml > out.yaml; diff semantically against deploy.yaml; the export report lists firewall and egress rules, process workloads, run_before, and for now health checks, metrics, volumes, init containers, config files and placement as unexpressed; a runtime = "process" job yields no Job; a shared-runc job becomes an ordinary Job.
